newsitem.title: UK: Granada reaps 600 mln pounds from disposals.
newsitem.headline: Granada reaps 600 mln pounds from disposals.

text.p: British media and leisure company Granada Group Plc said on Wednesday it realised 600 million pounds ($967.9 million) from its disposal programme last year and was making good progress this year.
"All of our divisions are trading ahead of last year, with pleasing results in a number of areas," Granada said in a statement.
The company also said it was pleased with the level of interest in its planned disposal of Welcome Break motorway service areas, which had a 40 percent rise in operating profit.
Granada said its Media Group improved its share of all TV advertising, with net advertising revenue ahead of last year.

"Restaurants, too, have made good progress. Granada Motorway Service areas increased catering sales with the successful introduction of Little Chef units, retail sales and fuel volume continued to move ahead," the company said.
Granada said sales at Travelodge were up, while Food Services had higher operating profits and its hotels division continued to see improvements in sales and yields.
Granada said its direct rental firm, DVR, showed strong growth potential, although certain proposals in the British government's budget would clearly affect the TV rental business.
"At this stage we are still establishing the exact effect and timing of the changes, and are actively making representations on the proposals," the firm said.

Granada had increases in volume and market share in its satellite systems supply business, although retail volume increases were offset by lower margins, in line with the market generally, the company said.
Granada's shares fell 9.0 pence to 875 by 1120 GMT.Z ($1=.6199 Pound)
